svg.aria-label: How ZAAFPulse works: local logs, second-brain sources and integrations are collected, cached, aggregated and served on 127.0.0.1; apps and code tools reach any model and the agents through the Agent Gateway

g.text: Serves on 127.0.0.1 only. No telemetry; outbound calls go only to the providers, sources and integrations you configure. Request logs never keep prompt text.
